name: Long Text Block Hook
trigger: Long block takes ~15s to read, extending watch time
template: [2-4 sentence setup: who is involved, what is about to happen, and why the outcome is uncertain]

name: This Is What We Do Every Time
trigger: Shared everyday situation makes viewer see themselves
template: this is what we do every time [relatable recurring situation]
examples: this is what we do every time our daughter poops

name: If Brand Ads Were Honest
trigger: Parody title promises a brand truth nobody says

name: Text Block Context Hook
trigger: Unexpected combination hints a reaction is coming

name: Headline Plus Backstory Subtitle
trigger: Second text layer adds context and a secondary hook
template: [Short headline hook block] / [one-line backstory explaining why this is happening]
examples: Making my wife PB&J Spaghetti.. 😳😂 / my pregnant wife started putting a 'craving' and 'yuck' list on the fridge

name: My First Attempt At
trigger: Beginner stakes; viewer waits to see how it goes
examples: MY FIRST ATTEMPT AT COMPETITIVE GOLF 🫣
